blocks.text: The End is wide and dark, and its islands are small. Each one has a compass that never forgets the way.

Sanctum Compass: the Sky Sanctum, from the 2nd dragon death.
Forge Compass: the Wing Forge, from the 3rd.
Refinery Compass: the Cloud Refinery, from the 4th.
Summoning Compass: the Summoning Sanctum, from the 5th; it points straight up.
Fountain Compass: the Offering Fountain, from the 5th.
Each compass points to its structure in the End, like a compass bound to a lodestone. Outside the End, its needle spins aimlessly.

Lost or never received? Stand on the central island of the End, within 192 blocks of its centre, when a dragon dies. Every player there receives the compass of each structure already unlocked, unless they already carry one. Bring friends: everyone gets their own.
